no_github_actions.name: apiverve-whoislookup
no_github_actions.summary: WHOIS Lookup is a domain WHOIS API that reads the registry's RDAP or WHOIS record for any domain and returns the registrar, creation and expiry dates, nameservers, EPP status codes explained in plain English, transfer-lock and privacy flags, the registrant country where it is published, and domain age in days and years.

no_github_actions.name: apiverve-websitetotext
no_github_actions.summary: Website to Text converts any webpage URL into plain text stripped of HTML tags. It returns the extracted body copy, page title, meta description, publication date, and detected language code.

no_github_actions.name: apiverve-websitetopdf
no_github_actions.summary: Website to PDF renders any public web page into a PDF document from a submitted URL. It returns a temporary signed download link, unique filename, and expiration timestamp, with paid plans adding the page count, paper size, custom margins, landscape layout and background printing control.

no_github_actions.name: apiverve-websitescreenshot
no_github_actions.summary: Website Screenshot renders webpage screenshots from any URL as PNG, JPEG or WebP, with ads blocked and cookie notices dismissed. It returns a signed download link with an expiration timestamp, supporting custom viewport dimensions up to 3840 pixels wide, single-element capture by CSS selector, a capture delay, a page-load wait strategy and JPEG or WebP quality.

no_github_actions.name: apiverve-websitereadability
no_github_actions.summary: Website Readability analyzes live web pages to score their reading difficulty and educational grade level. It returns Flesch Reading Ease, Flesch-Kincaid grade level, word count, sentence count, and estimated reading time.

no_github_actions.name: apiverve-weather
no_github_actions.summary: Weather is a current weather API that reports conditions for any city name or zip code: real-time temperature and wind speed with compass direction, in both metric and imperial units, with the location's coordinates, time zone and local time, day or night, and a UV risk level. Paid plans add a 7-day forecast with daily highs, lows, rain chance and conditions for the week ahead.

no_github_actions.name: apiverve-vindecoder
no_github_actions.summary: VIN Decoder turns a 17-character Vehicle Identification Number into the vehicle it identifies. Returns make, model, year, trim, body class and manufacturer, plus engine specifications, plant of manufacture, and the safety equipment fitted to that specific build. Optionally adds every safety recall issued for that vehicle and its NHTSA 5-star crash-test rating.

no_github_actions.name: apiverve-weatherseasons
no_github_actions.summary: Weather Seasons calculates astronomical solstice and equinox dates for any target year. It provides exact timestamps and reference timezones for the March and September equinoxes and the June and December solstices.

no_github_actions.name: apiverve-usernameprofanity
no_github_actions.summary: Username Profanity flags offensive or inappropriate usernames before they reach your database. Send any candidate handle to receive a clear true or false profanity check result; paid plans add the matched words and categories, reserved-name and contact-detail checks, a masked version of the username and a single allowed verdict.

no_github_actions.name: apiverve-usernamegenerator
no_github_actions.summary: Username Generator creates handle suggestions from a person's name or email address. It returns an array of suggested usernames based on the input, while paid plans can request multiple options at once.

no_github_actions.name: apiverve-useragentgenerator
no_github_actions.summary: User Agent Generator creates realistic user agent strings for desktop, mobile, and tablet devices. Each request outputs the complete string with parsed browser and operating system names and versions, while paid plans add engine and CPU details.

no_github_actions.name: apiverve-useragentparser
no_github_actions.summary: User Agent Parser parses user agent strings to extract browser, operating system, and hardware details. It identifies device types, CPU architecture, and bot traffic, so you can run user agent detection on every incoming HTTP request.

no_github_actions.name: apiverve-urlunshortener
no_github_actions.summary: URL Unshortener expands shortened links to reveal their final destination URL and destination domain. Send any short link to inspect the resolved address and redirect count; paid plans add the full redirect chain.

no_github_actions.name: apiverve-urllookup
no_github_actions.summary: URL Lookup resolves any web address to its hosting server IP address, country, and continent in real time. Paid plans add city, state, coordinates, timezone, and EU membership status.

no_github_actions.name: apiverve-urltitle
no_github_actions.summary: URL Title fetches the HTML title tag of any web page in real time from a target URL. Paid plans also retrieve an array of every H1 heading tag found on the page.

no_github_actions.name: apiverve-sunposition

no_github_actions.name: apiverve-sunrisesunset
no_github_actions.summary: Sunrise Sunset calculates exact sunrise and sunset times, twilight stages, and golden hour windows for any latitude and longitude coordinates. no_github_actions.name: apiverve-stockmarketopentimes
no_github_actions.summary: Stock Market Open Times checks if a global stock exchange is currently trading and provides its opening and closing times. On paid plans, add schedule=true for the exchange's local time, half-day early closes, and the next open and close with a countdown in minutes.

no_github_actions.name: apiverve-streetaddressparser

no_github_actions.name: apiverve-starslookup

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-whoislookup
no_pyproject_toml.summary: WHOIS Lookup is a domain WHOIS API that reads the registry's RDAP or WHOIS record for any domain and returns the registrar, creation and expiry dates, nameservers, EPP status codes explained in plain English, transfer-lock and privacy flags, the registrant country where it is published, and domain age in days and years.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-websitetotext
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Website to Text converts any webpage URL into plain text stripped of HTML tags. It returns the extracted body copy, page title, meta description, publication date, and detected language code.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-websitetopdf
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Website to PDF renders any public web page into a PDF document from a submitted URL. It returns a temporary signed download link, unique filename, and expiration timestamp, with paid plans adding the page count, paper size, custom margins, landscape layout and background printing control.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-websitescreenshot
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Website Screenshot renders webpage screenshots from any URL as PNG, JPEG or WebP, with ads blocked and cookie notices dismissed. It returns a signed download link with an expiration timestamp, supporting custom viewport dimensions up to 3840 pixels wide, single-element capture by CSS selector, a capture delay, a page-load wait strategy and JPEG or WebP quality.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-websitereadability
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Website Readability analyzes live web pages to score their reading difficulty and educational grade level. It returns Flesch Reading Ease, Flesch-Kincaid grade level, word count, sentence count, and estimated reading time.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-weather
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Weather is a current weather API that reports conditions for any city name or zip code: real-time temperature and wind speed with compass direction, in both metric and imperial units, with the location's coordinates, time zone and local time, day or night, and a UV risk level. Paid plans add a 7-day forecast with daily highs, lows, rain chance and conditions for the week ahead.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-vindecoder
no_pyproject_toml.summary: VIN Decoder turns a 17-character Vehicle Identification Number into the vehicle it identifies. Returns make, model, year, trim, body class and manufacturer, plus engine specifications, plant of manufacture, and the safety equipment fitted to that specific build. Optionally adds every safety recall issued for that vehicle and its NHTSA 5-star crash-test rating.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-weatherseasons
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Weather Seasons calculates astronomical solstice and equinox dates for any target year. It provides exact timestamps and reference timezones for the March and September equinoxes and the June and December solstices.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-usernameprofanity
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Username Profanity flags offensive or inappropriate usernames before they reach your database. Send any candidate handle to receive a clear true or false profanity check result; paid plans add the matched words and categories, reserved-name and contact-detail checks, a masked version of the username and a single allowed verdict.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-usernamegenerator
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Username Generator creates handle suggestions from a person's name or email address. It returns an array of suggested usernames based on the input, while paid plans can request multiple options at once.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-useragentgenerator
no_pyproject_toml.summary: User Agent Generator creates realistic user agent strings for desktop, mobile, and tablet devices. Each request outputs the complete string with parsed browser and operating system names and versions, while paid plans add engine and CPU details.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-useragentparser
no_pyproject_toml.summary: User Agent Parser parses user agent strings to extract browser, operating system, and hardware details. It identifies device types, CPU architecture, and bot traffic, so you can run user agent detection on every incoming HTTP request.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-urlunshortener
no_pyproject_toml.summary: URL Unshortener expands shortened links to reveal their final destination URL and destination domain. Send any short link to inspect the resolved address and redirect count; paid plans add the full redirect chain.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-urllookup
no_pyproject_toml.summary: URL Lookup resolves any web address to its hosting server IP address, country, and continent in real time. Paid plans add city, state, coordinates, timezone, and EU membership status.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-urltitle
no_pyproject_toml.summary: URL Title fetches the HTML title tag of any web page in real time from a target URL. Paid plans also retrieve an array of every H1 heading tag found on the page.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-triviagenerator
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Trivia Generator is a trivia and quiz API that serves random trivia questions complete with multiple-choice options and the correct answer. Paid plans can filter questions across topics like history, science, geography, and pop culture.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-unitconverter
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Unit Converter converts values between 185 units across 23 measures, from length, mass and volume to speed, pressure, data size, energy and electrical units. Pass a numeric value with source and target unit codes to get the converted result and unit abbreviations. On paid plans, precision sets the decimal places and conversions=true adds the value in every unit of the same measure.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-translator
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Translator is a language translation API that translates plain text or HTML into target languages using standard language codes. Submit any string with a target language code to receive the translated text, both language names, and the confirmed or auto-detected source language.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-titlecaseconverter
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Title Case Converter formats text strings into specific editorial style guidelines and capitalization standards. Send raw headline text and a chosen rule set like APA, Chicago, or AP to receive properly capitalized copy.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-timezonelookup
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Timezone Lookup resolves any city or IANA zone name to its local time, UTC offset, and calendar date. Responses include 12-hour and 24-hour clocks plus the minute offset from GMT.

no_pyproject_toml.name: openrois-engine
no_pyproject_toml.summary: OpenRoIS engine: the recursive RoIS HRI Engine, with its WebSocket server and client

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-thesaurus
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Thesaurus finds synonyms and alternative terms for any word. Supply a single target word to receive an array of matching synonyms.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-texttocolor
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Text to Color converts natural language color names into hexadecimal color codes. Send descriptive color phrases to receive matching hex values and channel counts, with paid plans adding RGB, HSL, and CMYK formats.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-textsimilarity
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Text Similarity compares two text strings and calculates their percentage match score. It returns case-insensitive and case-sensitive similarity scores plus the count and proportion of differing words.

no_pyproject_toml.name: openrois-components-core
no_pyproject_toml.summary: OpenRoIS component SDK: write a RoIS HRI Component as a Python class

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-textsummarizer
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Text Summarizer condenses raw text into concise summaries of a specified sentence count. Pass up to 5,000 characters to extract key points into readable summaries, with paid plans adding word counts and reduction metrics.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-textlanguage
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Text Language is a language detection API that detects the language of any input string, returning the full language name and its two-letter ISO 639-1 code. Send plain text passages or short snippets to identify incoming multilingual content.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-tenseconverter
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Tense Converter rewrites text into past or future tense. Submit any passage with your chosen target tense to receive the transformed wording and a flag indicating whether the text changed.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-swiftcodelookup
no_pyproject_toml.summary: SWIFT Code Lookup identifies the bank institution, branch, city, and country code behind any SWIFT or BIC code. Search by code or query by bank name to verify matching financial institutions and branch locations.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-sunposition
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Sun Position calculates the sun altitude and azimuth, plus compass bearing, for any geographic coordinates and time. Provide latitude and longitude to read sun elevation angles and daylight status; paid plans add panel aiming angles and shadow ratios.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-sunrisesunset
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Sunrise Sunset calculates exact sunrise and sunset times, twilight stages, and golden hour windows for any latitude and longitude coordinates. Paid plans can specify custom dates and receive solar noon. With local=true, the response names the IANA timezone of the coordinates on any plan, and paid plans also get each time in local time with its UTC offset.

no_pyproject_toml.name: comatype
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Comatype runtime for Python (client `c` and server `s`)

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-stockmarketopentimes
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Stock Market Open Times checks if a global stock exchange is currently trading and provides its opening and closing times. Pass an exchange code like NYSE or LSE to get current open status (open, closed, weekend or holiday), the holiday name, official exchange name, and session hours. On paid plans, add schedule=true for the exchange's local time, half-day early closes, and the next open and close with a countdown in minutes.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-streetaddressparser
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Street Address Parser is an address parsing API that breaks raw US street addresses into structured location components. Pass any single-line address string to extract the building number, directional, street name, street type, unit, city, state abbreviation, and postal code. Set standardize=true to get the address type (street, PO box or intersection) free, and on paid plans the mailing-format delivery line, last line and ZIP+4.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-starslookup
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Stars Lookup retrieves physical and positional stellar data by star name or astronomical classification. Query individual stars or filter by spectral class to obtain mass in kilograms, distance in light-years, and stellar type.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-spfvalidator
no_pyproject_toml.summary: SPF Validator checks the Sender Policy Framework (SPF) DNS record for a domain to verify if it’s valid and optionally whether a given IP address is authorized to send emails for that domain.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-acronymexpander
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Acronym Expander resolves acronyms and abbreviations into their full meanings, complete with subject categories and definitions. Submit any short term up to 20 characters to get matching expansions and explanations for each domain.
